verdicts.title: Non-commutative crepant resolutions of toric singularities with divisor class group of rank one
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: We prove the existence and give a classification of toric non-commutative crepant resolutions (NCCRs) of Gorenstein toric singularities with divisor class group of rank one. We prove that they correspond bijectively to non-trivial upper sets in a certain quotient of the divisor class group equipped with a certain partial order. This classification allows us to prove that all toric NCCRs of such toric singularities are connected by iterated Iyama-Wemyss mutations, and hence are derived equivalent
verdicts.judge_reasoning: The abstract concerns toric non-commutative crepant resolutions and divisor class groups of rank one in toric singularities, with no mention of CNF formulas, SAT, or clause set complexity—it shares only the 'divisor class group' vocabulary.
